findings.title: Call to nonexistent no-argument passkey helper prevents compilation
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but its superclass only defines `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`. There is no no-argument overload in this class hierarchy, so this source does not compile. Pass `context.getUser()` (or add an appropriate overload) before merging.

findings.title: Conditional passkey setup is skipped for unauthenticated login screens
findings.body: The new `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())` predicate requires a non-null user, while an initial browser login has no user selected yet. Previously `fillContextForm` was explicitly invoked in that case whenever passkeys were enabled, which sets the challenge and conditional-UI form attributes used to initiate a passwordless WebAuthn login. As a result, initial username/password-form logins no longer render or initialize conditional passkeys, and passkey-only users cannot start a passkey login until some other step identifies them.
